display.purpose: Section headings inside a workspace card. The largest type in the product.

headline.purpose: App title in the header bar. The only use of negative tracking (-0.5px).

title.purpose: Sub-headings, modal titles, and table column headers.

body.purpose: Default text. Item names lift to 600 so the name wins against the id beside it.

label.purpose: Every button, select and input. Interactive text is always heavier than prose.

mono.purpose: Item ids only, prefixed #. Never for language.

shadows.name: ambient-header
shadows.purpose: Elevation step 1 — the header bar detaching from the app gradient.

shadows.name: workspace
shadows.purpose: Elevation step 2 — the main content card and the Dashboard card.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Elevation step 3 — modal cards and the loading panel, over a blurred scrim.

shadows.name: icon-tile
shadows.purpose: The 40px item icon tile. Not part of the three-step scale.

motion.name: row-state
motion.purpose: Table row and dropdown row background changes.

breakpoints.name: window-default
breakpoints.purpose: Tauri default window width (1400x600). Not a media query — the toolbar reflows via flex-wrap instead.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Commits an action — Save Changes, Open Filter, Browse Folder. One per surface. Hover and focus rules are prescribed by DESIGN.md and not yet in source.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: #fff; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #6366f1 0%, #4f46e5 100%); border: none; border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 18px; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 0.2s, transform 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6366f1; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Create Button
components.description: Reserved for actions that bring a new row or file into existence — Add Item, Create New Filter File. Never used for save confirmation.
components.css: .ds-btn-create { font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: #fff; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #10b981 0%, #059669 100%); border: none; border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 18px; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 0.2s, transform 0.2s; } .ds-btn-create:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-create:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6366f1; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Navigation and toggles — Save As…, Switch File, theme toggle, inactive Tradeskill Only. Translucent fill plus the inverted hairline border.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: #f8fafc; background: rgba(51, 65, 85, 0.6); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 18px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(51, 65, 85, 0.85); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6366f1; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Row Remove Button
components.description: Per-row destruction at 15% intensity, so a 200-row table does not read as 200 alarms. The full Struck Red gradient is reserved for bulk removal.
components.css: .ds-btn-remove { font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: #ef4444; background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15); border: none; border-radius: 6px; padding: 6px 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s; } .ds-btn-remove:hover { background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.28); } .ds-btn-remove:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ef4444; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Toolbar and modal text entry. box-sizing: border-box so a full-width field never overflows its card. The focus ring is prescribed, not yet implemented.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="🔍 Search item name or ID..." />
components.css: .ds-input { font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: #f8fafc; background: rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.8); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 16px; min-width: 240px; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #94a3b8; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6366f1; outline-offset: 2px; border-color: #6366f1; }

components.name: Action Select
components.description: The per-row loot action chooser — the single most-used control in the product. Four options, mapped to the on-disk filter ids 1-4.
components.html: <select class="ds-select"><option>Always Store</option><option selected>Always Loot</option><option>Always Merge</option><option>Always Sell</option></select>
components.css: .ds-select { font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #f8fafc; background: rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.8); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-select:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6366f1; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Workspace Card
components.description: The glass surface every working region sits on. Translucent slate over the app gradient, 20px backdrop blur, elevation step 2, inverted hairline border.
components.html:
EverQuest UI Directory

Select your EverQuest folder to auto-detect character loot files.
components.css: .ds-card { background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.65); backdrop-filter: blur(20px); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); border-radius: 24px; box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25); padding: 24px; } .ds-card-title { font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; color: #f8fafc; margin: 0 0 8px 0; } .ds-card-sub { font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: #94a3b8; margin: 0; }

components.name: Warning Banner
components.description: Margin Amber's only job: advisory, never blocking. A 12% fill inside a 40% border, with the resolving action on the right.
components.html: ⚠️ 3 item(s) in this filter aren't in the item database.
components.css: .ds-banner { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.12); border: 1px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.4); border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 16px; } .ds-banner-text { font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; color: #f8fafc; } .ds-banner-action { font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #fff; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #6366f1 0%, #4f46e5 100%); border: none; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 14px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-banner-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6366f1; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Toast
components.description: Bottom-right stack. The 4px left border carries the status accent — green success, red error, indigo info. A signature move; reuse it rather than swapping in icons.
components.html: Loot filter saved successfully!
components.css: .ds-toast { font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #f8fafc; background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.92); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12); border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); padding: 12px 16px; max-width: 360px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-toast--success { border-left: 4px solid #10b981; } .ds-toast--error { border-left: 4px solid #ef4444; } .ds-toast--info { border-left: 4px solid #6366f1; }

components.name: Item Row
components.description: The signature component. Icon tile, mono id, 600-weight name, action select, right-aligned remove. Row hover is prescribed here but dead in source (theme.tableRowHover is declared and never used).
components.html: #1042Fine Steel Dagger
components.css: .ds-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; text-align: left; } .ds-row { border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); transition: background 0.2s; } .ds-row:hover { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03); } .ds-cell { font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; color: #f8fafc; padding: 12px 20px; } .ds-cell--icon { width: 60px; } .ds-icon { display: inline-block; width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15); box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2); background: linear-gradient(135deg, #334155, #1e293b); } .ds-cell--id { font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 13px; color: #94a3b8; } .ds-cell--name { font-weight: 600; } .ds-cell--actions { text-align: right; }

narrative.overview:
EQL Loot is a supply officer's ledger, not a dashboard. Its centre of gravity is a dense sortable table where every row is an item id, a name, and one of four decisive actions — loot it, store it, merge it, sell it. Everything else on screen exists to get the quartermaster to that table faster and to keep the manifest correct while the game rewrites it underneath. The glass, the gradient and the blur are the room the ledger sits in; they are packaging, and packaging never outranks the rows.

The material is a translucent indigo night. Surfaces are rgba slate at 65% opacity over a three-stop gradient that runs deep navy → violet-black → near black, with every card carrying a backdrop-filter blur. That atmosphere is constant and unranked. The elevation scale on top of it is not: three shadow weights separate the header, the workspace and the modal layer, and that ordering is a hierarchy future work must respect. The material is atmospheric; the elevation scale is structural. Both are true at once, and that tension is the system's defining rule.

Controls are tactile and game-adjacent. Anything that commits an action wears a saturated 135° gradient — indigo to add or save, green to create, red to destroy. Anything that merely navigates stays a quiet translucent slate. Radii are generous and scale with the surface they wrap, so the whole interface reads soft-cornered rather than engineered. The emoji glyphs on toolbar buttons are deliberate: this tool lives beside a fantasy MMO and is allowed to sound like it. What it must never become is enterprise-dashboard grey.
keyCharacteristics: Translucent slate surfaces at 65% opacity over an indigo→violet→black gradient
A constant backdrop-filter blur (8–20px) as ambient material
Three structural elevation steps: header, workspace, modal
Saturated 135° gradients reserved strictly for committing actions
Radii that scale with surface size (6px control → 24px workspace)
Full dark/light parity; neither theme is the afterthought
Emoji glyphs as functional iconography, not decoration

rules.name: The One Meaning Rule
rules.body: Each saturated ink carries exactly one verb: indigo commits, green creates, red destroys, amber warns. A new feature does not get to borrow green because it looks friendly. If a new verb appears, it earns a new ink or it reuses the one whose meaning it actually shares.

rules.name: The Two-Intensity Rule
rules.body: A destructive action at row scale uses the 15% wash (rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15) fill, #ef4444 text). Only an action that destroys many rows at once earns the full gradient. Repetition of a full-strength danger colour down a table is a defect, not emphasis.

rules.name: The Inherit Rule
rules.body: Form controls must declare font: inherit. Without it the browser serves Arial at 13.33px inside an interface set in Inter at 16px, and the mismatch is visible on every button in the app. Any global stylesheet this project grows starts with button, input, select, textarea { font: inherit; }.

rules.name: The Weight-Not-Family Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy is built from weight and size within a single family. Do not introduce a second display face, a serif, or a condensed cut to signal importance.

rules.name: The No Outer Scrollbar Rule
rules.body: The application shell never scrolls. New full-height regions get their own overflow-y: auto container with a radius and a border; they do not extend the page.

rules.name: The Three Steps Rule
rules.body: There are three elevation steps and no fourth. A new surface picks the step matching its role — chrome, work, or interruption — and inherits that exact shadow value. Inventing an intermediate weight flattens the ranking for everything else.

rules.name: The Glass-Needs-Ground Rule
rules.body: Every translucent surface sits on the app gradient, never on another translucent surface. Stacked glass turns the blur to mud and the border contrast to nothing.

rules.name: The Radius-Tracks-Size Rule
rules.body: Pick a radius from the surface's footprint, not its component name. A 40px-tall control takes 8–10px; a full-height card takes 24px. Two nested surfaces never share a radius.

dos: Do reserve saturated gradients for actions that commit something. Indigo commits, Ledger Green creates, Struck Red destroys, Margin Amber warns.
Do pick a shadow from the three named steps and inherit its exact value.
Do scale the corner radius to the surface footprint (6px control → 24px workspace card), and never give nested surfaces the same radius.
Do keep every new surface translucent over the app gradient, with a backdrop-filter blur and the inverted hairline border.
Do ship dark and light together. Every value in this file has a light-mode counterpart in buildGlassTheme; a one-theme feature is an unfinished feature.
Do add button, input, select, textarea { font: inherit; } to the global style block, and self-host Inter under public/fonts/ with @font-face.
Do add a visible :focus-visible ring in Manifest Indigo to every control. Nothing in the app has one today.
Do wire theme.tableRowHover to an actual row hover, or delete the token.
Do treat emoji glyphs as part of the voice — 🔨 for tradeskill, 💾 for save, ⚡ for bulk. They are load-bearing, not filler.
donts: Don't drift toward enterprise-dashboard grey: flat corporate chrome, hairline-boxed panels, and no atmosphere. The glass and the colour are the point of this product's surface.
Don't stack a translucent surface on another translucent surface.
Don't invent a fourth elevation weight or a one-off box-shadow.
Don't repeat a full-strength danger gradient down a table; that is what the 15% wash exists for.
Don't introduce a second type family, a serif, or a condensed cut. Weight and size carry the hierarchy.
Don't load fonts, icons, or styles from a CDN. The app ships everything it renders.
Don't let the application shell scroll. New full-height regions scroll inside their own bordered container.
Don't add a colour whose meaning duplicates one already in the palette.
